title: Mercury Trucking Company
author: Alan Trewartha
description:
Somehow you've landed the contract to haul supplies to the scientific outposts in the Jupiter system. How did it go wrong on the first run? You're such a pro too…

An INCOMPLETE game I worked on years ago, and has been lying unloved on my mac for 20 years.

This is a playable intro to a much larger game I plotted out, but never completed. Once you get out of the ship, you can explore the first moonbase and some of the puzzles work, but may not be great. (Looking in the source there's so much stuff in there I'd forgotten about. You may be able to get to another moon!)
